scripts.start: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue,cyan" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue,cyan" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.install:all: concurrently -n "backend,frontend,database" -c "blue,cyan,magenta" "npm i --prefix backend" "npm i --prefix frontend" "npm i --prefix database"
